messages:
maya: Quick check — was debugging client telemetry and saw UA duplicated when using our Python SDK with a reverse proxy.
maya: Root request had `User-Agent: RedwoodClient/1.2.3` then proxy added `User-Agent: InternalProxy/2.0` and downstream service saw both merged into a single header string.
jason: hmm, proxies concatenating is annoying. Do we set UA in middleware and again in the transport?
liam: IIRC we set `user_agent` on the Session and also attach in `on_request` hook for retries. Likely double attach on redirects.
anika: Is this the same bug where tracestate also got duplicated across retries? saw similar in go SDK.
sara: yes — observed tracestate entries duplicated after a 307 redirect -> retries re-add trace header instead of reusing existing.
maya: Example headers on the wire:
```
User-Agent: RedwoodClient/1.2.3, InternalProxy/2.0
traceparent: 00-abcdef...-1234-01
tracestate: rd=1,rd=1
```
jason: we should dedupe at the SDK boundary. Add guard: if header exists, don't append, only append missing fields.
liam: For tracing propagation, more correct is to treat tracestate as ordered list; on retry we should not re-insert our entry if present. Patch proposal in #3245.
anika: Streaming quirk: for SSE / websocket streaming the handshake sets headers once. If the streaming code uses a new transport for reconnect, opt-out flags (e.g., CLIENT_METRICS=false) weren't being re-applied to reconnect transport.
sara: that explains why some users see metrics after toggling opt-out at runtime.
maya: Proposed action items:
- small change in python/js SDK: check and dedupe `User-Agent` and `tracestate` before setting (PR 3245)
- ensure env/opt flags applied on reconnect paths for streaming (PR 3246)
- add unit test for redirect+retry preserving tracestate ordering
jason: I'll own dedupe PR for python. liam can you own streaming reconnect flag on go + python? anika will do the tracestate CI tests.
liam: yep I'll take streaming. Will add e2e with a dummy proxy that mutates UA and force reconnect.
anika: also propose a tiny docs blurb in devex about header behaviors + recommended proxy config (strip vs append), to prevent surprises for customers.
maya: thanks — can we try to land both PRs this sprint? blocker if not.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: PRs 3245 (python), 3246 (python streaming) added to eng-oncall review queue :white_check_mark:
jason: started a draft, pushing in a moment.
sara: FYI: customer reported toggling `REDWOOD_CLIENT_METRICS=false` in k8s wasn't applied because sidecar injected a header; we'll reach out once PRs land.
maya: great. ping here when PRs merged, then I will coordinate a short customer note.
